reviews.quote: Called Hayden to provide a quote on re roofing our house he returned our enquiry quickly and the quote was clearly detailed and explained. Given a start date and can say the communication was great the end result was amazing. Before and after photos show the difference. Thank you
reviews.author: Wayne Watson

reviews.quote: I was unable to get a roof replacement for 6 months in Hamilton. I saw Vic West add on Facebook so I gave them a call. Hayden promptly gave me quote and came straight away to measure up. Before I knew it 2 teams of trades were here and off with the old roof new battens and sisal new sheets on capped and flashed all in one day. Vic West are a professional team and I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Roland Peacock

reviews.quote: Replacing your roof is such an overwhelming thing but Hayden was amazing from first phone call to being on time with appointments, quotes (which was well below what we were expecting 😊) and getting the job done so quickly!! He and his team were wonderful making quick work of getting the old roof off and new one on and cleaning up as well and it looks unbelievable like a new house! I couldn’t recommend Vicwest Roofing enough!!!
reviews.author: Rebecca Schultz

reviews.quote: These guys did a top job for me, going from tile to tin in Wendouree. Would recommend them 100%. Done in two days. Great effort. Thanks again. Cheers Don
reviews.author: Donald Stewart

reviews.quote: Hayden and his team replaced a rusting old iron roof on my old Creswick cottage with Colorbond ( Pale Eucalypt). Parts of the house were over 100 years old and it wasn’t an easy job. There were solar panels to be removed and replaced as well. The team did a great job, arriving very early each day and working solidly until knock off time. They ran a very tidy worksite and obviously took pride in workmanship, which was good to see. All the debris was removed at the end.
reviews.author: Helen Hanson
